Article Name: Effects of Sand/Fly Ash and the Water/Solid Ratio on the Mechanical Properties of Engineered Geopolymer Composite and Mix Design Optimization
Author: Muhammad Zahid, Nasir Shafiq
Curing method: demolded, wrapped in plastic wrap, oven 60 C for 24 h, then lab 23 C until test
Source table/page: Table 6 (mix), Table 3 (solution composition), Table 4 (PVA), Sec 2.3 (curing), Table 7 (fc)
Conversions / notes: M1. Binder = fly ash only (high-Ca, CaO 19 %). Table 6 gives alkaline solution 0.36 and Na2SiO3/NaOH 2.5 (taken as solution mass ratio) per FA: WG/B = 0.36*2.5/3.5 = 0.2571 (Na2O 14.7 %, SiO2 29.75 %, H2O 55.52 %); 8 M NaOH solution = 0.36/3.5 = 0.1029 of FA with 26 % NaOH solids (Table 3) -> NaOH/B 0.0267, its 74 % water (0.0761) + extra water 0.035 -> W/B. Cross-check: stated W/GP solids 0.22 reproduced within 0.003. Water in WG not added. PVA 2 vol% of total volume. Flexural strength only (no direct tension), so no tensile columns. Compressive: 50 mm cube, ASTM C109, tested day 28 (curing time column = age at test).
